note: Traffic incidents (sim f9148be; audio contexts). Contexts: horn, shout, gesture, forceIn, shove, inspect, argue, details; plus double_park, cut_off, slow, horn_chain, bystander (sim's original states). Adults only; no slurs; 1974.

lines.text: Lay off the horn! The horn don't make it move!
Everybody honk! That'll fix it! Brilliant!
Come on, come on, come on!
Hey! You double-parked! Move it or I move it for you!
Two minutes, he says! It's been twenty!
It's green! Green! What are you waiting for, a letter?
Take your time, pal! I'll just live here now!
Yeah? Yeah? Same to you, Mac!
Oh, that's nice. Your mother teach you that?
Go back to Jersey!
Let me in! Come on, let me in, it's a merge!
I'm coming over! I'm coming over! Look out!
Every man for himself. Welcome to New York.
Don't you touch my car! Don't you touch me!
Back off! Back off or I swear to God!
You want to go? We'll go. Right here on Ninth.
Look at that. Look at my bumper. It's a brand-new bumper.
Oh, beautiful. That's a dent. That's a whole dent.
My brother-in-law's gonna kill me. It's his car.
You call that a dent? This whole car is a dent.
You backed into me! I was parked! Parked is not moving!
You stopped short! Who stops short on Eighth Avenue?
The light was yellow! Yellow means go faster, everybody knows that!
Don't you point at me! I've been driving since Truman!
Oh, it's my fault. Sure. I drove into my own car.
You got a license? Show me the license! Who gave you a license?
I had the right of way! The right of way, pal!
You were doing fifty on a side street! Fifty!
Oh, sure, blame the guy who was standing still.
My lawyer's gonna love you. He's got a boat to pay for.
Don't raise your voice at me! I'm raising my voice at you!
Look, it's ninety degrees. Can we yell faster?
Alright, alright. Write down your insurance. Print, I can't read script.
Let's just swap names and get out of the street before a cop comes.
This your real name? 'John Smith'? You're kidding me.
Forget the cops. Twenty bucks and we never met. Deal?
Where's the meter maid when you need her? Never! That's where!
You cut me off! Where'd you learn to drive?
Signal! It's the stick by your hand! Use it!
Sunday driver on a Tuesday. Wonderful.
Listen to that. Twenty horns and not one brain.
Listen to 'em. Like a symphony, if the symphony hated each other.
Every summer. Heat makes everybody crazy.
Ten bucks says the guy in the plaid hat wins.
